program_name: Bachelor of Arts in Irish Music

programme_facts.value: This course also has an alternative entry route via the Certificate in Music and Dance. Students apply directly to University of Limerick. Students who successfully complete the one-year certificate have the opportunity to join year two of the degree programme.
If you are an Irish traditional musician or singer seeking to deepen your practice and performance while exploring other artistic forms, this course is for you.

Applicants will be proficient performers but do not necessarily need a formal music and dance background (ie. Leaving Certificate music or grade examinations such as those from Comhaltas or London College etc.).
